items.title: How a sponsored product ad runs
steps: A brand sets a keyword and a bid
The retailer runs an auction for the slot
The sale is reported to the brand
items.why: The search triggers an auction, and the sale is reported back.

items.title: How closed-loop measurement works
steps: A shopper sees or clicks an ad
The exposure is logged against their account
The retailer matches the sale to the exposure
The results are aggregated for privacy
The brand sees sales and ROAS
items.why: Exposure and purchase are matched by the retailer, then reported in aggregate.
